fusions.name: Thinned Blood
fusions.desc: Spits thinning venom that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow Echo
fusions.desc: A hiss that carries 4 tiles ahead of you and deals 11 resonating damage to everything in it. It stuns each target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Heat-Pit Sense
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Taking the Warmth
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
